Name: Echo's Diversity Mod
Author: Blyndshot
Description:
[b][size=4]Description and Credits:[/size][/b]
I've been a huge fan of the various diversity patches for Stardew Valley since it came out in 2016. So, I put together some of the edits I've made! I might update it in future with additional characters, though I really recommend checking out these mods as well (they're what I use in my game!):

Original inspiration for the Diversity Mod:
[url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/diverse-stardewvalley-hiatus-im-dead.109748/]https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/diverse-stardewvalley-hiatus-im-dead.109748/[/url]

Unofficial continuation (seasonal outfits, a huge group collaboration that is INCREDIBLE):
[url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580603-diverse-stardew-valley-dsv-seasonal]https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580603-diverse-stardew-valley-dsv-seasonal[/url]

Dae's Edits: (these are out-of-date, currently, and probably will be for the foreseeable future, but I just love them a lot.)
[url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/daes-character-redesigns-jodi-vincent-kent-jas-marnie.127409/]https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/daes-character-redesigns-jodi-vincent-kent-jas-marnie.127409/[/url]﻿ 

[size=4][b]Installation:
[/b][/size]Installation instructions are included in the files, but:
[list]
[*]Install SMAPI, and then Content Patcher.
[*]Unzip the downloaded mod into your [b]Stardew Valley > Mods [/b]folder.
[*]Edit config.txt to your heart's content.
[/list]
[b][size=4]Settings:[/size][/b]
Make sure you check out the preview folder to set the options to what you like in the config.json file. [i](To disable a certain portrait entirely, set the config to 0)
[/i]Wizard-specific note: setting his option to '2' enables compatibility with Werewolf Master's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius mod[/url]. It adds seven new expressions to the existing portrait.

[b][size=4]Notes:[/size][/b]
In the event that these sprites and portraits become out of date, or you'd like to make a seasonal update / edited version of them: [i]please feel free to.[/i] Just make sure you credit me and link back to this page. No need to ask for permission, but I would love to be linked to it:)
